authors: Jesús Roberto Martínez, Miguel Ángel Espinoza
instructions: Rapscallion is a roleplaying game that plunges you and your friends into the waters of the Great Sea, churning with danger and wonder! The call of treasures unknown is too great for you and your crew of misfits to ignore. Board your ship with your steadfast crewmates and set sail across the unknown to secure your legacy and might.The Great Sea Awaits!
